title: Unsafe deserialization via dill.loads (python) — review required
description: The python call dill.loads rebuilds objects from a byte stream without a type allowlist, so the payload itself chooses which classes are constructed. Prefer a data-only format; when a native serializer is required, pass an explicit allowlist (dill.dump_safe). This lexical rule flags the call and does not resolve where the bytes come from.
remediation: Replace dill.loads with a data-only parser, or constrain the accepted types (dill.dump_safe).
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the dill.loads call; origin of the bytes and the reachable classes are out of scope.
